## Per-chapter highlights

### Chapter 1 — ‘Be Strong and of a Good Courage’: The LORD Commissions Joshua

*status:* draft
*themes:* covenant, prophetic-call, inheritance

After Moses' death, the LORD speaks directly to Joshua and gives the foundational charge for entering the land. The five-fold "be strong and of a good courage" formula completes its installation across Deut 31 and Joshua 1, spoken by Moses, by the LORD, and finally by the people themselves to Joshua. The chapter is the narrative-prophetic culmination of the Joshua- succession typological framework that Num 27 first installed.
